commonSituations.label: 공통 · 정색하고 노려보기
commonSituations.description: 심하게 인상을 쓰거나 화내지 않고 차갑고 흔들림 없는 시선을 보냅니다.
instructions: Use a level unwavering stare, slightly lowered upper eyelids, a relaxed mouth, and only faint inward brow tension.
Keep all established face, hair, body, outfit, accessory, prop, and rendering details unchanged.
undesiredInstructions: Deep frowning, shouting, bared teeth, severe brow compression, or exaggerated hostility.

commonSituations.label: 공통 · 분노
commonSituations.description: 집중된 시선과 강하게 내려간 눈썹, 굳은 턱으로 분노를 분명히 드러냅니다.
instructions: Pull the brows sharply down and inward, tense the jaw and cheeks, and open the mouth mid-outburst with focused furious eyes.
Keep all established face, hair, body, outfit, accessory, prop, and rendering details unchanged.
undesiredInstructions: Comedic anger marks, cute pouting, playful annoyance, or a relaxed face.

commonSituations.label: 공통 · 혐오
commonSituations.description: 과장된 개그 얼굴이 아닌 통제된 역겨움과 거부감을 표현합니다.
instructions: Curl the upper lip slightly, wrinkle the nose bridge, pull the head back a fraction, and hold a controlled repulsed gaze.
Keep all established face, hair, body, outfit, accessory, prop, and rendering details unchanged.
undesiredInstructions: Seductive contempt, playful teasing, comic distortion, vomiting, or an angry shouting face.

commonSituations.label: 공통 · 공포
commonSituations.description: 놀람이나 흥분이 아니라 몸이 굳고 떨리는 실제 공포를 표현합니다.
instructions: Widen the eyes with centered pupils, lift and draw the brows together, part the mouth, and pull the shoulders inward in visible fear.
Keep all established face, hair, body, outfit, accessory, prop, and rendering details unchanged.
undesiredInstructions: Comic surprise, excitement, seductive fear, a fighting stance, or supernatural eye effects.

commonSituations.label: 공통 · 공포에 빠져 울기
commonSituations.description: 겁에 질린 눈을 뜬 채 양쪽 뺨으로 눈물을 흘리며 몸을 떱니다.
instructions: Keep the frightened eyes open as tears pool and run down both cheeks; make the mouth and chin tremble and draw the shoulders inward.
Keep all established face, hair, body, outfit, accessory, prop, and rendering details unchanged.
undesiredInstructions: Happy tears, pretty posing, closed dry eyes, comedic waterfall tears, or calm sadness.

commonSituations.label: 공통 · 데포르메 SD 종이 얼굴
commonSituations.description: 캐릭터의 얼굴과 머리카락만 종이에 그린 뒤 외곽선을 따라 오린 듯한 SD 페이퍼크래프트입니다.
instructions: Give a gentle closed-mouth smile: slightly raised lip corners, relaxed level eyebrows, and softly open eyes. Keep it warm and natural, never blank, pouty, tense, wide-eyed, or startled.
Use a cute super-deformed face with large simplified eyes, a tiny nose, and a tiny mouth while preserving every recognizable signature facial feature.
Draw the colored face and hair on matte white paper. Leave a narrow continuous unprinted white margin around the entire hair, ears, cheeks, and chin, then cut with scissors along its outside edge.
The white contour must be bare paper, not ink, glow, or adhesive. Show a thin paper edge and slight scissor irregularity; keep it flat, clean, centered, and free of any rectangular sheet.
Show only the paper face-and-hair silhouette with no neck, shoulders, torso, body, clothing, hands, or separate props.
undesiredInstructions: Biological severed head, gore, neck stump, body, clothing, hands, rectangular paper sheet, image-frame border, drawn or glowing white outline, sticker backing or gloss, thick cardboard, standing doll, or 3D figurine.
Blank, vacant, sullen, surprised, alarmed, pouty, tense, asymmetric, or open-mouth expression; staring eyes, raised eyebrows, or flat or downturned mouth.
